messages.content: I was charged twice for my order #4821. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.
I've checked my bank statement again and yes, two identical charges of £49.99 went out this morning.
It's been 2 hours now and nobody has responded. I need this sorted today.
I can't log into my account. I've reset my password three times and still getting an error.
The error says 'account temporarily locked'. I haven't done anything wrong, I just forgot my password.
I have an order arriving tomorrow and I need to check the delivery slot. Please unlock my account.
Still locked out. This is really frustrating, I've been a customer for 4 years.
My parcel was supposed to arrive Monday, it's now Thursday and tracking hasn't updated in 4 days.
The tracking just says 'in transit' since Sunday. Is it lost?
I contacted the courier and they said to contact you as the sender. What is going on?
I want to cancel my subscription immediately. Please confirm cancellation and stop any future charges.
I cancelled through the app but I'm not sure it went through. Can you confirm on your end?
The app keeps crashing every time I try to open my order history. This has been happening for 2 days.
I'm on iPhone 15, iOS 17.4. Tried uninstalling and reinstalling, still crashing.
Just tried on my partner's Android phone and same issue. So it's not my device.
Someone has accessed my account without my permission. I can see orders I didn't place. Please help urgently.
There are three orders I didn't make. Two delivered to an address I don't recognise.
I've changed my password but I'm worried my payment details have been used. Please freeze my account.
I've also reported this to my bank. Please respond as a matter of urgency.
My delivery arrived damaged. The box was completely crushed and the item inside is broken.
I've taken photos of the packaging and the damaged item. Where do I send them?
This was a gift for my daughter's birthday which is tomorrow. Can you arrange an urgent replacement?
The discount code SAVE20 isn't working at checkout. It keeps saying invalid code.
I got the code from your email newsletter sent yesterday. I can forward it to you if needed.
The offer expires today so I really need this resolved quickly.
I've been waiting 3 weeks for my refund. You said 5-7 business days. What is going on?
I returned the item on the 1st and have the Royal Mail tracking proving delivery on the 3rd.
I've called twice and been told 'it's being processed'. That's not good enough after 3 weeks.
I'm going to raise a chargeback with my bank if this isn't resolved by end of day.
The two-factor authentication code isn't arriving on my phone. I'm completely locked out.
I've waited 10 minutes, requested the code 4 times, still nothing.
My number is correct in the account settings, I can see it ending in the right digits.
I accidentally ordered the wrong size. The order was placed 10 minutes ago, can you cancel it?
Order number is #7743. I need a medium not a large.
Your website says next day delivery but I've been waiting 5 days. This is false advertising.
I ordered specifically because of the next day delivery promise. I needed this for an event.
The event was yesterday. The item is now useless to me. I want a full refund including delivery.
I never signed up for a premium plan but I've just been charged £29. I want this reversed now.
Looking at my statements this has been happening for 3 months. That's £87 total.
I want all three months refunded. I never agreed to this charge.
If I don't hear back today I'm going to the Financial Ombudsman.
My account email needs updating. I no longer have access to the email address I registered with.
The old email was from my previous employer. I left 6 months ago and can't access it.
I can verify my identity any other way you need — order history, billing address, phone number.
The item I received is completely different from what was shown in the photos online.
I ordered a navy blue jacket and received a black one. The product code on the label is different too.
I need the correct item before the weekend. Can you arrange an express replacement?
I'm getting a 500 server error every time I try to check out. My cart has 8 items in it.
I've tried on two different browsers and my phone. Same error every time.
Some of the items in my cart are low stock. I'm worried they'll sell out while I wait for this to be fixed.
I paused my subscription last month but you charged me anyway. This is unacceptable.
I have a screenshot of the pause confirmation. The charge went out the day after I paused.
Please refund the charge and confirm my subscription is actually paused this time.
My tracking link just says 'label created' and hasn't moved in 6 days. Is my order lost?
I've contacted the courier and they said the parcel was never collected from your warehouse.
Can you confirm whether it was actually dispatched? The money has already left my account.
It's been 6 days of silence. I need answers today please.
I ordered a birthday present for tomorrow and just got an email saying it's delayed by a week. Devastating.
Is there any way to get it here tomorrow? I'll pay for express if needed.
If it can't arrive tomorrow then please cancel and refund so I can buy elsewhere.
Your returns policy says 30 days but the returns portal is rejecting my request after 22 days.
I purchased on the 1st. Today is the 23rd. That is clearly within 30 days.
The portal error says 'return window expired' which is factually incorrect.
Please either fix the portal or process this return manually.
The product I bought stopped working after one week. It should be covered under warranty.
It's a blender. It just stopped turning on completely. No visible damage.
I have the receipt and the warranty card. How do I make a warranty claim?
I can't download my receipts from the account page. The download button does nothing.
I need these for a business expense claim by end of week. It's quite urgent.
Tried on Chrome, Firefox and Edge. Nothing happens when I click download on any of them.
The item was listed as in stock when I ordered but I've just been told it's out of stock. Please refund me.
Why was it showing as available if you didn't have stock? This is misleading.
Please process the refund today. Order number #5512.
I was charged a cancellation fee but I cancelled well within the free cancellation window.
I cancelled at 9:15am. Your policy says free cancellation up to 10am. The maths doesn't add up.
I have the cancellation confirmation email timestamped 9:15am if you need proof.
My order shows as delivered but I never received it. Nobody knocked and there's no card through the door.
The tracking photo shows it was left outside a door but that's not my door.
I've checked with neighbours and nobody has it. I think it's been delivered to the wrong address.
This was £120 worth of goods. I need this resolved urgently.
I'm being charged VAT but I'm a registered business and should be exempt. Please correct this.
My VAT number is GB123456789. I provided this when signing up but it's still being applied.
Can you reissue the last three invoices with the correct VAT treatment?
How long does it take to process a return? I sent mine back 2 weeks ago and heard nothing.
Royal Mail tracking confirms delivery to your warehouse on the 8th. Reference RM8823774GB.
It's now been 14 days since you received it. When will I get my refund?
My saved payment method keeps getting removed. I have to re-enter my card every single order.
This has happened on the last four orders. Something is clearly wrong with my account.
I received someone else's order. My name is on the label but the contents are completely wrong.
I can see another customer's name on the items inside. I haven't opened everything.
I imagine someone else has my order too. How do we sort this out?
The order confirmation email never arrived. I've checked spam and nothing. Did my order go through?
The money has left my account but I have no order number or confirmation.
My email is correct on my account, I can see it in settings.
Your chat support told me my refund was approved but it's been 10 days and nothing has arrived.
I have the chat transcript where your agent confirmed the refund on the 7th.
My bank says no refund has been initiated. So either it wasn't processed or there's an error on your end.
I want the name of the agent who approved it and why it hasn't been processed.
